response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / SUM(sc.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate

assumptions.assumption: Each group's rate is its total file size divided by its total duration, using scans with a recorded file size and positive duration. A NULL risk evaluation status forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Each group's rate is the average of its individual scans' GB-per-minute rates.
